primary_question.question: Why does my Gulab Jamun stick or tear?
evidence: Do not boil the milk, because hot milk can make the dough sticky.

related_questions.question: Why is my Gulab Jamun too dense or dry?
evidence: Do not knead firmly, or the jamuns can become dense.

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Gulab Jamun?
evidence: Do not add rose water while boiling hard, or its aroma can fade.

related_questions.question: Why is my Gulab Jamun too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not fry on high heat.

related_questions.question: How can I improve my Gulab Jamun?
evidence: Do not leave large khoya chunks, or the jamuns may crack while frying.
Do not add extra baking powder, because too much can make the jamuns break.
Do not boil the milk, because hot milk can make the dough sticky.
Do not pour in all the milk at once.
Do not knead firmly, or the jamuns can become dense.
